title: streamText: Logic for `text-end` differs from logic for `reasoning-end`
body:
Logic for `text-end`

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/67f7e765458500102d6a4e60a4687692b0d03efd/packages/ai/src/generate-text/stream-text.ts#L732-L734

differs from logic for `reasoning-end`

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/67f7e765458500102d6a4e60a4687692b0d03efd/packages/ai/src/generate-text/stream-text.ts#L765-L783

which means that we are ignoring provider metadata from the `text-end` event.

linked_prs.title: fix(ai): align logic of `text-end` with `reasoning-end`
linked_prs.body:
## Background

As a fix for #8907, we now have the same logic to capture provider metadata for `text-end` as we did for `reasoning-end`

## Summary

Changed the logic for capturing provider metadata for `text-end` in `packages/ai/src/generate-text/stream-text.ts`

## Manual Verification

Modified test file to ensure the passed provider metadata is captured in `text-end`

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
The issue concerns provider metadata handling at the end of LLM-generated text streams, referencing logic tied to LLM provider integration and output management, which are agent-specific behaviors per the taxonomy (LLM operation issues: Incorrect model output handlers, Incompatibility with LLM providers).
